title: Electroporation of Thalassiosira pseudonana
author: Joshua Bugge
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yvqfw5w

steps.title: Grow T. pseudonana culture
steps.instruction: Grow Thalassiosira pseudonana in f/2‑supplemented sterile seawater until the culture reaches approximately 1.1 × 10⁶ cells · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Harvest cells from culture
steps.instruction: Keep all procedures at 4 °C on ice. Collect cells from 500 mL of the culture by centrifugation for 10 min at 3000 × g in ten 50 mL conical tubes. Discard the supernatant and resuspend each pellet in 1 mL of filter‑sterilized 375 mM sorbitol.

steps.title: Combine and concentrate cells
steps.instruction: Pool the resuspended cells into one 50 mL conical tube, centrifuge at 3000 × g for 10 min, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 800 µL of filter‑sterilized 375 mM sorbitol. Transfer the suspension to a 1.5 mL tube and keep on ice.

steps.title: Vacuum‑filter concentration
steps.instruction: Concentrate the cells by vacuum filtration to approximately 300 mL, then collect them by centrifugation in 50 mL conical tubes at 3000 × g for 10 min. Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of filter‑sterilized 375 mM sorbitol.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Combine the cells into a new tube, centrifuge at 3000 × g for 10 min, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of 375 mM sorbitol.

steps.title: Add linearized plasmid
steps.instruction: On ice, add linearized plasmid (dissolved in 250 mM sorbitol) to the cell suspension so that the final plasmid concentration is 0.15 µg · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Load electroporation cuvette
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the cell‑plasmid mixture to a pre‑chilled 2 mm gap electroporation cuvette.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Wipe the cuvette dry with a Kimwipe, place it in a Bio‑Rad Gene Pulser, and electroporate using 25 µF capacitance, 400 Ω resistance, and a field strength of 2.5 kV · cm⁻¹.

steps.title: Recover electroporated cells
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the electroporated cells to 10 mL of sterile f/2‑supplemented artificial seawater and incubate overnight at 17 °C under constant light (170 µE · m⁻² · s⁻¹).

steps.title: Plate on selective agar
steps.instruction: The next day, plate approximately 5 × 10⁸ cells on NEPC agar containing 100 µg · mL⁻¹ nourseothricin (NAT). Include no‑plasmid and no‑electroporation controls.

steps.title: Incubate plates
steps.instruction: Grow the plates under constant light (170 µE · m⁻² · s⁻¹); colonies typically appear after about 10 days.

steps.title: Transfer colonies to 96‑well plates
steps.instruction: Pick individual colonies into 300 µL of f/2‑supplemented artificial seawater in 96‑well plates. Measure optical density at 600 nm or 680 nm with a plate reader as a proxy for growth.
